summary_zh: 山东省纪委监委消息，济宁市委常委、统战部部长、政法委书记白平和涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: Bai He-ping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Jining Municipal Committee in Shandong Province, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.
